title: Caffe Technical Paper
summary: The Caffe authors recorded the framework in the paper 'Caffe: Convolutional Architecture for Fast Feature Embedding' on June 20, 2014, describing Caffe as a fully open-source deep-learning framework implemented in C++ with CUDA and bindings for Python and MATLAB.
significance: A primary-source, day-precision documentation milestone for Caffe that records the framework without converting the paper date into an unsupported invention, system-birth, or public-release date.

verification.note: The authors' primary paper gives a June 20, 2014 date and directly describes Caffe as a fully open-source framework, its C++/CUDA implementation, Python and MATLAB bindings, and BVLC maintenance/development. The official Caffe project page independently corroborates Yangqing Jia as creator, Evan Shelhamer as lead developer, BAIR/community development, and BSD 2-Clause licensing. This candidate records only the paper milestone and source-explicit organizational attribution; it does not infer an invention/system-birth date, exact public-release date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry edge, influence, causality, or other unsupported relationship.
